rules: Sunder cut A (A1 lead 14 design): one unhurried, heavy, accurate RISING FOREHAND from the stance's tail guard, hips first, nothing snatched; ends in the LEFT WIND that cut B starts from (no return to the stance). 0.70 s = 42 game frames; contact 14 f, cancel 22 f. Standing, both feet planted on the stance's spots.
notes: WIP (helper CUT-A2, 10 Nov): the ARC re-keyed. FULLY KEYED, no generated take: the base is 22 frames of idle_warden's take, wholly replaced by fit.start {clip idle_fight_a, bones all, over past the clip's end}; the keyed layers below make the motion. Hips first (yaw 0 -> +6 by f60 4, +40 at contact), the hand and blade stay on the stance to f60 4 (null keys), the hand goes out WIDE and long along her right, the blade lags out to her right then whips round the hand through the target, carries up-left and lays back over the left shoulder. NO pole_keys on hand_r: an explicit pole at t 0 put hand_r 16 deg / upperarm_r 16 deg off the stance on frame 0 (limbs.pole_keys cannot take null); without a pole arm_ik keeps the stance's own elbow side. OPEN: no back-heel lift (the back foot stands under the pelvis, reach 0.94: the plant never needs to raise it), frame 0 stands 20 cm ahead of where the stance clip stands (fit.start takes the pose's turn and height, not its place), no fit.end so no spot check.
